grade_reason: No statement by Rep. Hamadeh about AI, let alone catastrophic AI risk, was found in news coverage or on his official site since 1 January 2025.
notes: Eight web searches ran; none was refused. None of them returned any page with Hamadeh speaking about AI. His official press release list (hamadeh.house.gov/media/press-releases, first page only, 17 September to 11 November 2026) has no AI release; the 11 November 2026 veterans release mentions H.R. 7103, the 'Improving Emerging Tech Opportunities for Veterans Act', which was not opened and is a vote on a package, not a statement about AI risk. An attempt to open the next press release page (?page=1) returned the same nine releases, so releases before 17 September 2026 were not reviewed. The azfamily.com article of 14 September 2026 on AI control were checked; the article does not mention him. He is not listed among the cosponsors of H.R. 10538, the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act of 2026, on fastdemocracy.com (12 cosponsors, all Democrats); congress.gov was not checked directly. As instructed, the many-signer House letters of August and September 2026 were not searched for.
